name: multi-model-cell03-provider-launch-authorization
title: Prepare M2-a Cell 03 provider launch authorization guardrails without inventing spend approval
description: B-11be completed metadata-only M2 provider authorization with USD 0.00 and providerExecutionAuthorized=false. The next protocol step is Cell 03 E2 A4 same-family calibration, but real provider execution still requires an exact human-approved nonzero budget amount, currency, approval source, dated executor/reviewer snapshots, prompt digest, tool-surface digest, runner ownership, and duplicate policy. This story records and validates a narrow Cell 03 launch authorization guardrail: a Cell 03 packet may be considered executable only when the exact budget approval and all required metadata are present; otherwise it must remain fail-closed with no provider calls, no result rows, no Cell 06 execution, and no paper/product claim unlock.
